name: Summon Giant (General)
body:
You can summon brutish humanoids to fight by your side.

Prerequisite(s): Summon nature’s ally spell or ability.

Benefit(s): Add the following creatures to the list you can summon with summon nature’s ally.

Spell-like abilities with a duration other than instantaneous used by summoned creatures from this list are dispelled when the summoned creature disappears.

Summon nature’s ally I: orc
Summon nature’s ally II: half-ogre
Summon nature’s ally III: thawn
Summon nature’s ally IV: ogre, firbolg
Summon nature’s ally V: cave giant, river giant, wood giant
Summon nature’s ally VI: hill giant, slag giant, stone giant
Summon nature’s ally VII: cliff giant, desert giant, fire giant, frost giant, jungle giant
Summon nature’s ally VIII: ash giant, cloud giant, taiga giant
Summon nature’s ally IX: ocean giant, storm giant
